title: AI Privacy and Safety for Students
body: Get useful help with a prompt that contains only what is needed.
notes: AI can be wrong. Check facts and the tool's current rules.
aria: AI Privacy and Safety for Students. Get useful help with a prompt that contains only what is needed.

title: Who can use this class?
body: Students ages 13–17 and college students can work through it, including with a parent.
notes: No sensitive examples from the learner are needed.
aria: Who can use this class?. Students ages 13–17 and college students can work through it, including with a parent.

title: Share the minimum
body: A tool may store what you enter. Identify the task before choosing what to share.
notes: A sample work shift rarely needs a street address.
aria: Share the minimum. A tool may store what you enter.

title: Read the live policies
body: For FirstCareerSteps data practices, use the live Privacy Policy and Terms.
notes: Do not invent retention or training promises.
aria: Read the live policies. For FirstCareerSteps data practices, use the live Privacy Policy and Terms.

title: Keep these out
body: Never paste SSNs, passwords, card or bank numbers, ID documents, full home addresses, medical details or other people's private information into general AI tools.
notes: Use category labels only.
aria: Keep these out. Never paste SSNs, passwords, card or bank numbers, ID documents, full home addresses, medical details or other people's private information into general AI tools.

title: Pause and check permission
body: Be careful with school IDs, exact schedules, photos, restricted essays and confidential work.
notes: Ask whether the task needs that input at all.
aria: Pause and check permission. Be careful with school IDs, exact schedules, photos, restricted essays and confidential work.

title: Activity: sort eight items
body: Sort fictional categories into okay, ask first and never share.
notes: Use sample categories rather than real identifiers.
aria: Activity: sort eight items. Sort fictional categories into okay, ask first and never share.

title: Privacy also belongs to others
body: Do not upload another student's grade, a coworker's number or an unauthorized photo.
notes: Choose a fictional example instead.
aria: Privacy also belongs to others. Do not upload another student's grade, a coworker's number or an unauthorized photo.

title: Age and accounts
body: FirstCareerSteps requires 13 or the higher local minimum and guardian permission under 18. LinkedIn requires at least 16.
notes: Link to the current terms; do not direct younger users to join LinkedIn.
aria: Age and accounts. FirstCareerSteps requires 13 or the higher local minimum and guardian permission under 18.

title: Mid-quiz: three paste decisions
body: Decide what to do with a password, a classmate's grade and a fictional role description.
notes: Explain each choice.
aria: Mid-quiz: three paste decisions. Decide what to do with a password, a classmate's grade and a fictional role description.

title: Keep the useful context
body: Use roles, initials and broad locations when enough for the task.
notes: Remove details that identify another person.
aria: Keep the useful context. Use roles, initials and broad locations when enough for the task.

title: A shorter prompt still works
body: Compare an oversharing grocery-job request with a minimal task description.
notes: Mark why each removed detail was unnecessary.
aria: A shorter prompt still works. Compare an oversharing grocery-job request with a minimal task description.

title: Photos are optional
body: Do not send ID photos or someone else's photo to a general AI tool.
notes: Refer to site policy for product-specific processing.
aria: Photos are optional. Do not send ID photos or someone else's photo to a general AI tool.

title: Screen recording: trim the prompt
body: Plan a 6–8 minute redaction walkthrough.
notes: Use an annotated fictional before-and-after until recorded.
aria: Screen recording: trim the prompt. Plan a 6–8 minute redaction walkthrough.

title: If you shared something private
body: Stop adding details. Use deletion controls if available, seek a trusted adult for serious exposure and change a compromised password.
notes: Avoid promising that deleting a chat erases all copies.
aria: If you shared something private. Stop adding details.

title: Check the tool and its settings
body: Review its audience, history options and rules before use.
notes: No instructions for evading age gates or school filters.
aria: Check the tool and its settings. Review its audience, history options and rules before use.

title: Worksheet: What I Will and Won’t Share
body: Write personal rules and one safer version of a fictional prompt.
notes: Keep the worksheet local.
aria: Worksheet: What I Will and Won’t Share. Write personal rules and one safer version of a fictional prompt.

title: Your FirstCareerSteps choices
body: Use the builder, review /privacy and /terms, and find account deletion at /dashboard/settings.
notes: No new identity or school fields.
aria: Your FirstCareerSteps choices. Use the builder, review /privacy and /terms, and find account deletion at /dashboard/settings.

title: Common traps
body: A whole inbox, a yearbook page or a sibling's details share much more than a resume task needs.
notes: Select the smallest useful excerpt.
aria: Common traps. A whole inbox, a yearbook page or a sibling's details share much more than a resume task needs.

title: Recap
body: Decide what is needed, what is private and who can authorize sharing.
notes: Students can use sample data.
aria: Recap. Decide what is needed, what is private and who can authorize sharing.

title: Optional completion record
body: Preview a truthful completion line.
notes: Do not present it as a privacy credential.
aria: Optional completion record. Preview a truthful completion line.

title: End question: never paste
body: Identify a sensitive category among ordinary prompt details.
notes: Use no real secrets.
aria: End question: never paste. Identify a sensitive category among ordinary prompt details.

title: End question: another person's data
body: Choose a respectful way to work without a classmate's details.
notes: Permission and necessity both matter.
aria: End question: another person's data. Choose a respectful way to work without a classmate's details.

title: End question: safer rewrite
body: Find the prompt that keeps the task and removes location and contact details.
notes: Explain what the answer needs.
aria: End question: safer rewrite. Find the prompt that keeps the task and removes location and contact details.

title: End question: exposed password
body: Choose changing the password and seeking help as appropriate.
notes: Do not rely on chat deletion alone.
aria: End question: exposed password. Choose changing the password and seeking help as appropriate.

title: End question: LinkedIn age
body: Recall the minimum age and the possibility of a higher local requirement.
notes: Offer offline practice for younger students.
aria: End question: LinkedIn age. Recall the minimum age and the possibility of a higher local requirement.

title: Answer review
body: Explain each answer and offer a retry.
notes: Pass at four out of five.
aria: Answer review. Explain each answer and offer a retry.

title: Decision tree: a restricted essay
body: Identify the teacher's restriction before choosing an input.
notes: Use an invented example if allowed.
aria: Decision tree: a restricted essay. Identify the teacher's restriction before choosing an input.

title: Decision tree: a team picture
body: Ask who appears and whether sharing is permitted or needed.
notes: A role description can replace the image.
aria: Decision tree: a team picture. Ask who appears and whether sharing is permitted or needed.

title: Decision tree: an interview invite
body: Keep the job task while removing private contact details.
notes: Do not paste the invitation wholesale.
aria: Decision tree: an interview invite. Keep the job task while removing private contact details.

title: Compare the three decisions
body: Show when to stop, seek permission or substitute a fictional prompt.
notes: Use text labels as well as visual cues.
aria: Compare the three decisions. Show when to stop, seek permission or substitute a fictional prompt.

title: Practice one safe rewrite
body: Build a version that still gets the learner useful interview practice.
notes: Check it for remaining identifiers.
aria: Practice one safe rewrite. Build a version that still gets the learner useful interview practice.

title: Close: keep the worksheet
body: Choose one sharing rule to use this week.
notes: Do not ask for examples of actual secrets.
aria: Close: keep the worksheet. Choose one sharing rule to use this week.

title: Use the minimum
body: Try a prompt with the least information needed and check its answer.
notes: Link to the live policies for further questions.
aria: Use the minimum. Try a prompt with the least information needed and check its answer.
